evals.prompt: Try this new guideline wording on our support bot before publishing it and compare the answer with what users get now.
evals.expected_output: Creates and fetches an exact complete prompt draft, captures an artifact-free active baseline, then runs a separate like-for-like candidate with artifacts.promptVersionId and markAsTest without publishing.
assertions: Runs the active baseline first with no artifacts
Persists the complete prompt draft through agent configuration and fetches its exact non-truncated version
Passes only the exact version ID through artifacts.promptVersionId rather than inline prompt text
Uses a fresh equivalent candidate conversation with markAsTest true
Captures baseline and candidate interaction and event IDs
Does not publish or imply that the candidate became active

evals.prompt: Our new refund article job says COMPLETED but returned no article ID. Put its wording inline and test it against the bot anyway.
evals.expected_output: Refuses the inline or missing-ID shortcut, treats completion without a persisted draft ID as a blocker, and waits for a concrete fetched draft before using knowledgeArticleDraftIds.
assertions: Does not treat COMPLETED without a persisted knowledge ID as usable candidate evidence
Does not put raw article text in Generate Answer artifacts
Requires a concrete persisted draft ID and exact draft fetch
Uses artifacts.knowledgeArticleDraftIds only after the draft exists
Keeps publication separate from candidate validation

evals.prompt: We have prompt draft pv_42, knowledge drafts kd_7 and kd_8, snapshot ks_3, and eligible refund rule version rv_17. Test the whole candidate before launch.
evals.expected_output: Runs a controlled active baseline, tests each candidate dimension separately with exact IDs, then runs one combined candidate only after isolated results are understood.
assertions: Verifies every artifact ID belongs to the intended workspace and agent context
Uses separate prompt-only, knowledge-only, snapshot-only, and eligible-rule-only conversations before combining
Keeps message, role, metadata, user attributes, channel, and controlled identity equivalent
Uses markAsTest true and fresh interaction IDs for every variant
Records the exact artifact set and event evidence per run
Verifies documented snapshot and draft-article composition semantics before combining
Does not publish any candidate

evals.prompt: Test brand-new unassigned intent Rulebook draft rv_new through ruleVersionIds before we publish or assign its rule.
evals.expected_output: Blocks the unsupported runtime override, explains that the owning rule must already be published and assigned, and routes the new draft to structural field/flow review instead of pretending Generate Answer executed it.
assertions: Fetches and verifies the actual rule kind and version
Does not pass a brand-new unassigned draft through artifacts.ruleVersionIds
Explains the published-and-assigned owning-rule eligibility requirement
Uses structural preview or review rather than full runtime proof
Does not publish or assign merely to satisfy the test request

evals.prompt: Run our Test Set against this unpublished prompt draft so we know how the live regression suite performs.
evals.expected_output: Explains that a Test Set cannot apply the unpublished draft, uses exact-ID Generate Answer candidate validation first, and keeps the later live-agent regression run plus its possible Action effects separate.
assertions: Does not claim a Test Set can apply promptVersionId
Uses Generate Answer with the persisted exact prompt draft for candidate behavior
States that Generate Answer creates the candidate conversations and events
Routes persistent cases and asynchronous live-agent regression to fini-api-testing after publication
States that the Test Set run may invoke Actions or external APIs
Does not call the live Test Set run proof that the unpublished draft was tested

evals.prompt: Tell me whether yesterday's exact failed response would change with pv_42 while preserving that historical thread.
evals.expected_output: Routes the historical-context regeneration to Replay with the exact prompt artifact rather than substituting a new clean-turn draft validation.
assertions: Chooses Replay because the exact stored historical context must be preserved
Keeps the original conversation unchanged
Uses the exact prompt artifact ID rather than inline draft text
Does not mislabel a replay as an active baseline and fresh candidate comparison
Routes replay event alignment and reuse semantics to fini-api-testing

evals.prompt: Use markAsTest on our production cancellation agent so the draft check cannot actually cancel anything.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the false safety premise, inspects reachable Actions, and requires a controlled workspace/account/input because markAsTest labels traffic but does not suppress external effects.
assertions: States that markAsTest is not a dry-run or Action-suppression flag
Inspects active and overridden Rulebooks for reachable Action Tool nodes
Uses a controlled workspace, agent, customer identity, and input before executing
Treats Generate Answer as a write that creates conversation and events
Records any Attribute or Action effects separately from answer quality

evals.prompt: Use whichever knowledge snapshot is latest for the candidate test; I do not have its ID.
evals.expected_output: Does not infer a latest snapshot, resolves and verifies one exact workspace-owned knowledgeSnapshotId first, or omits/blocks that dimension when no exact ID is available.
assertions: Does not invent or infer knowledgeSnapshotId from article state or recency language
Uses the owning knowledge workflow to obtain an exact workspace-owned snapshot ID
Records the exact snapshot ID before Generate Answer
Tests the snapshot as its own candidate dimension before combination
Blocks or omits the snapshot override if exact identification is unavailable
